question: On which river is India's smallest river island Umananda situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra River**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Umananda Island** is situated on the **Brahmaputra River** in the state of Assam, India.
 
• It is considered the **smallest inhabited riverine island** in the world.
 
• The island is known for the **Umananda Temple**, dedicated to Lord Shiva, which attracts many pilgrims and tourists.
 
• Umananda Island is also known as **Peacock Island** due to its picturesque and serene environment.
 
• Regular ferry services are available from the banks of the Brahmaputra to reach the island.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Brahmaputra River** is one of the major rivers of India, originating from Tibet and flowing through India and Bangladesh.
 
• The river is known for its **strong currents** and is prone to flooding during the monsoon season.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the **agriculture and economy** of the regions it flows through, particularly in Assam.
 
• The Brahmaputra is also significant for its **rich biodiversity**, supporting various species of flora and fauna.
 
• Efforts are continuously made to preserve the ecological balance and prevent pollution in the river.
